app.name: PocketChest
app.description: Private, self-hosted sharing for files and text. One Worker, one R2 bucket, no database.

inputs.description: Optional. At least 8 characters, with both letters and digits (otherwise it is ignored and one is generated). Leave empty on a first install and the app generates one: read it from the private R2 object auth/initial-owner-password.txt, then change it in Security settings. On an upgrade, leave empty to keep your current password; a value typed here does not replace an existing password.
inputs.label: Owner password
